```xml
<robot name="cabinet_sliding_doors">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Cabinet overall: width X=1.33, height Z=1.86, depth (Y) = 0.50 -->
  <!-- Origin: on floor under middle of object -->
  <!-- X: across width, Y: toward back (front faces -Y), Z up -->
  <!-- Coordinate convention: -Y is front, +Y is back -->
  <link name="base"/>
  
  <!-- =======================
       Materials
       ======================= -->
  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.60 0.43 0.25 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.45 0.32 0.20 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="glass_like">
    <color rgba="0.70 0.78 0.90 0.7"/>
  </material>
  <material name="metal">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.55 0.58 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <!-- =======================
       Cabinet panels
       Assumptions:
       - Nominal wall thickness: 0.02 m
       - Top/bottom thickness: 0.02 m
       - Inner opening approximated by subtracting walls on both sides
       ======================= -->

  <!-- Bottom panel -->
  <link name="bottom_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="22.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0107" iyy="0.0048" izz="0.0107" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.50 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.50 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Top panel -->
  <link name="top_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 1.85" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0096" iyy="0.0043" izz="0.0096" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 1.85" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.50 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 1.85" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.50 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Back panel -->
  <link name="back_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.245 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0027" iyy="0.0108" izz="0.0027" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.245 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.245 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.33 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left side panel -->
  <link name="left_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="18.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0027" iyy="0.0115" izz="0.0115" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.50 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.50 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right side panel -->
  <link name="right_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="18.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0027" iyy="0.0115" izz="0.0115" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.50 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.655 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.50 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Front frame rails (approximate) -->
  <link name="front_frame_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="3.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00036" iyy="0.00087" izz="0.00088" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.08 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.08 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="front_frame_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="3.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00036" iyy="0.00087" izz="0.00088" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.08 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.595 0.0 0.93" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.08 0.02 1.86"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- =======================
       Tracks (two separate front tracks):
       - placed near the front edge on the cabinet frame
       - track thickness 0.015, width 0.03 (in X), length ~0.42 in Y? We'll model as small bars
       - Track A (left half) and Track B (right half), they support each door separately.
       Sliding motion: along +X/-X (sideways), doors move relative to cabinet.
       ======================= -->

  <!-- Track A -->
  <link name="track_A">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00020" iyy="0.00060" izz="0.00060" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.02 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.02 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Track B -->
  <link name="track_B">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00020" iyy="0.00060" izz="0.00060" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.02 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.245 0.230 1.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.02 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- =======================
       Sliding doors
       Assumptions:
       - Door thickness 0.018 m
       - Door height ~1.84 m leaving 0.01 top/bottom clearance
       - Door depth spans cabinet opening but simplified with single plate
       - Door placed near front of opening (slightly behind front frame):
         front opening roughly ends at Y = -0.245 (half depth)
         We'll position doors around Y = -0.235 with thickness along X? No, thickness along Y.
       ======================= -->

  <!-- Door A (left front track) -->
  <link name="door_A">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <!-- Door size used for inertia: X=0.665, Y=0.018 (thickness), Z=1.84 -->
      <!-- approx diagonal inertias for box around its own COM (center at its origin) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0190" iyy="0.0072" izz="0.0907" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.665 0.018 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.665 0.018 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Door B (right front track) -->
  <link name="door_B">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0190" iyy="0.0072" izz="0.0907" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.665 0.018 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.665 0.018 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- =======================
       Fixed joints from base to structure
       ======================= -->
  <joint name="joint_bottom_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="bottom_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_top_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="top_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_back_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="back_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_left_side_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="left_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_right_side_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="right_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_front_frame_left_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="front_frame_left"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_front_frame_right_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="front_frame_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_trackA_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="track_A"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_trackB_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="track_B"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- =======================
       Sliding joints
       Motion axis: +X (sideways)
       Door local frame: we'll place the joint origin at the door's COM reference.
       Each door has two limits allowing them to slide past each other.
       ======================= -->

  <!-- Initial positioning:
       Door thickness along Y=0.018 centered at Y=-0.235 (near front).
       Door COM Z = 0.92 (since height 1.84 -> half 0.92) but visual/collision uses origin at local z=-0.009,
       so set link origin such that visual COM aligns at Z=0.92.
       We defined door visual origin at xyz="0 0 -0.009" meaning the geometry is centered at local z=0
       only if origin equals COM offset. For consistency, set joint origin at door link frame so that geometry COM is at Z=0.92.
       We'll set joint origin at (x=?, y=-0.235, z=0.929) because geometry origin is shifted -0.009 to place COM at z=0.92.
  -->

  <!-- Door A starts left side, roughly centered at x=-0.33 -->
  <joint name="joint_door_A" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door_A"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.3325 -0.235 0.929" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.33" upper="0.33" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Door B starts right side, roughly centered at x=+0.3325 -->
  <joint name="joint_door_B" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door_B"/>
    <origin xyz="0.3325 -0.235 0.929" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.33" upper="0.33" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Base inertia (light/no geometry but must exist as link) -->
  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.01"/>
      <inertia ixx="1e-6" iyy="1e-6" izz="1e-6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

</robot>
```
